name: v1.4.268
body: We shipped more than one release today. Check out [1.4.267](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.267) and [1.4.266](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.266) too. ## Bots on more agents, richer Slack & a faster Orca ✨ Bots can now run on Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Hermes, Slack gets scheduling and canvases, and Orca does less work in the background so it feels quicker. - 🤖 **Run bots on more agents:** Bots can run on Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Hermes, and OpenCode 2.x bots get their standing instructions. New bots get an identity card, and Soul & Memory have redesigned editors. - 🖼️ **Send images and files:** Attach images and files in bot chats, group chats and item comments, including to a bot on a paired computer. Images on a Slack request reach the agent as images. - 💬 **More from Slack:** `orca slack post --at` schedules a post for later, and new `pin`, `canvas`, `list` and `scheduled` commands cover pins, canvases and lists. Connecting Slack takes the copied token without extra clicks, and mentions read as names. - ⚡ **A lighter, smoother Orca:** Animations run smoothly again instead of about once a second, spinners and pulses draw fewer frames, credential reads move off the main thread, and automatic heap profiles are gone. Orca also suggests cleaning up workspaces when the disk is almost full. - 🧭 **More reliable workers and chats:** Chats cut by a crash or restart can continue, a worker's final report wakes the agent that started it, and worker names in chat open the worker. Chat also gets Antigravity, Claude, Codex and Droid fixes. - 🌐 **Annotate pages on remote hosts:** Browser annotations now work on remote hosts too. ## About Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: every managed agent session gets its tools and identity, bots can share on the owner's behalf, they follow Slack threads and Gmail triggers more reliably, and connecting them is clearer and safer. - **Every bot session gets its tools and identity:** Managed agent sessions are no longer limited to Claude and Codex; each one starts with the tools and identity it needs. - 🔗 **Bots can share, just like the owner:** Agent CLI callers can use Sharing the same way the owner does. - 💬 **Slack threads show what a bot is doing:** A thread now reflects what its turn is working on, and long answers arrive whole instead of cut up. - 📬 **Gmail triggers match the real sender:** Triggers match the sender's actual address, not a display name that can differ. - 🛡️ **Clearer access warnings:** The access confirm dialog now spells out what you are allowing before you connect a bot. ## Coming soon - Antigravity bug fixes - More connectors - Easier moving of bots between different machines - More performance improvements - Fix bots stall issues under heavy task load - Improved PR review workflow - More plugin API - Sidebar UX improvements --- ## What's Changed ### 🤖 Bots, connectors & access *Bots can run on Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Hermes, get redesigned Soul & Memory editors and a new-bot identity card, and take images and files in chats and item comments. Slack gains scheduled posts, pins, canvases and a smoother setup, and paired servers get clearer sign-in.* * Generate an avatar with an installed image-capable agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44361 * History sharing on Linux without perl takes Codex's lock coordination through flock(1) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45028 * Only mark a chat turn local when its journal proves Orca began it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45040 * Keep other computers' bots visible in the new-group picker by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45122 * Ask in a normal comment with quick replies, keeping the comment box by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45139 * Show
